raw.query: SELECT c.run_id, c.policy, c.quantile, c.provisioned_worker_seconds AS numerator, (8 * w.span_s) AS denominator, c.provisioned_worker_seconds / (8 * w.span_s) AS cost_ratio, l.p99_ms AS aggregate_p99_encoder_delay_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_cost c CROSS JOIN provenance.windows w LEFT JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l ON l.run_id = c.run_id AND l.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' WHERE c.run_id = 'aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_issuetime' AND w.window_name = 'aggregate';
raw.evidence: aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_issuetime has numerator=2410754.7 worker-s and denominator=3869278.4 worker-s (cost ratio = 0.6231), and meets the SLA on the aggregate (p99 delay of 588.37 ms vs 1000 ms bound) and every in-span episode (588.4 ms).
